title: Zabaykalsky Krai Receives One Twentieth of the Fuel It Needs
subtitle: Weekly deliveries of 1,050 tons amount to roughly 4,550 tons a month against a stated regional requirement of 88,000 tons.

source.name: Zabaykalsky krai fuel supply statements reported in Russian regional media

data.label: Actually delivered
data.annotation: 1,050 tons a week, hauled across one of Russia's longest supply lines.

supportingFacts.label: At this rate the region needs over nineteen weeks of shipments to cover one month of demand.
The krai has no refinery of its own and depends entirely on long-haul rail deliveries.

metadata.keyFinding: Deliveries cover about 5% of the region's stated monthly fuel requirement.
